fix(runtime): close automatic recovery gaps (#188)

* fix(runtime): retry after worker abandonment

Preserve capped fast retries while allowing one new retry when the latest dispatch records a newer durable worker abandonment.

* fix(cursor): keep retained prompts running

Avoid opening runtime-unknown Attention before a retained active prompt receives its first provider event.

* fix(runtime): recover orphaned restart workers

Persist abandonment when startup finds an unmatched worker start from a prior daemon process, allowing the bounded runtime-unknown retry path to resume automatically.

* fix(cursor): keep pending prompts running

Session-level ACP events can arrive before prompt-scoped activity. Trust the retained session pending state so those unrelated events do not force a recoverable live prompt into Unknown.

* fix(runtime): use causal recovery identity

Bind worker abandonment to a daemon instance and retry budget to the latest dispatch so wall-clock regressions cannot strand recoverable work. Preserve synchronous Cursor prompt returns as terminal evidence.

* fix(runtime): recover restart lifecycle gaps

* fix(runtime): recover worker lifecycle faults

* fix(runtime): bypass legacy recovery invariants

Modern worker evidence without causal abandonment belongs to the modern recovery path even when legacy dispatch predicates have changed.

* fix(runtime): replay committed worker completions

Durable completion evidence must be replayed before runtime-unknown recovery can cancel or replace its dispatch.

* fix(runtime): canonicalize commit receipts

Transport retries could append equivalent preparation receipts and make completion replay fail its one-to-one metadata gate. Register one canonical receipt per semantic request while preserving historical aliases for audit and completed artifact authority.

* fix(migrations): guard receipt rollback

Semantic retry commands can depend on the canonical registry without owning a same-command preparation row. Refuse downgrade instead of leaving those commands unreplayable by the previous runtime.

* fix(runtime): close automatic recovery gaps

Replay durable completions across worker restarts and replacement dispatches, refresh provider cancellation fences, and bound merge commit readback payloads.

Migrations 0127 and 0128 authorize commit-preparation replay and preserve repeated failed lifecycle events.

* refactor(cli): remove one-off wake command

Historical states that cannot recur are repaired with exact operator SQL instead of a permanent product interface.
